user.title: Xiaomi Air Conditioning Companion (gen 1)
user.description: Enter the local IP address and the 32 character hexadecimal MiIO token of the device.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect, check the IP address and token
error.invalid_token: The token must be 32 hexadecimal characters

play_ringtone.name: Play ringtone
play_ringtone.description: Play a built-in ringtone on the device.

play_user_audio.name: Play custom audio
play_user_audio.description: Play the audio file previously uploaded to the device.

upload_audio.name: Upload audio
upload_audio.description: Make the device download and store an audio file over HTTP.

url.name: Audio URL
url.description: HTTP audio URL reachable by the device

speak.name: Speak
speak.description: Render a short text and play it on the device. The audio is removed from the device again once it has been played.

message.name: Message
message.description: The text to speak, at most 300 characters.

speaker.name: Speaker
speaker.description: Microsoft Edge voice name, for example zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural.

api_key.name: API key
api_key.description: Key for the fallback text to speech service.

cleanup_audio.name: Clean up audio
cleanup_audio.description: Remove the uploaded audio file from the device. The device only has about 11 MB of storage, so it is worth cleaning up after a one-off announcement.

init.title: Options
init.description: Optional settings for the text to speech and the download address.

data.tts_base_url: Address the device can use to download the rendered audio
data.tts_api_url: Address of a fallback text to speech service, leave empty to use the Edge voices only
data.tts_api_key: API key of the fallback text to speech service
